an5.99:1.1: Sīho bhikkhave migarājā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ āsayā nikkhamati,
an5.99:1.4: samantā catuddisā anuviloketvā tikkhattuṃ sīhanādaṃ nadati,
an5.99:1.6: So hatthissa ce pi pahāraṃ deti, sakkaccaṃ yeva pahāraṃ deti no asakkaccaṃ,
an5.99:1.7: mahīsassa ce pi pahāraṃ deti, sakkaccaṃ yeva pahāraṃ deti no asakkaccaṃ,
an5.99:1.8: gavassa ce pi pahāraṃ deti, sakkaccaṃ yeva pahāraṃ deti no asakkaccaṃ,
an5.99:1.9: dīpissa ce pi pahāraṃ deti, sakkaccaṃ yeva pahāraṃ deti no asakkaccaṃ,
an5.99:1.10: khuddakānaṃ ce pi pāṇānaṃ pahāraṃ deti antamaso sasaviḷārānaṃ pi, sakkaccaṃ yeva pahāraṃ deti no asakkaccaṃ.
an5.99:2.1: Sīho ti kho bhikkhave Tathāgatass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa.
an5.99:2.2: Yaṃ kho bhikkhave Tathāgato parisāya dhammaṃ deseti, idam assa hoti sīhanādasmiṃ,
an5.99:2.3: bhikkhūnaṃ ce pi bhikkhave Tathāgato dhammaṃ deseti, sakkaccaṃ yeva Tathāgato dhammaṃ deseti no asakkaccaṃ,
an5.99:2.4: bhikkhunīnaṃ ce pi bhikkhave Tathāgato dhammaṃ deseti, sakkaccaṃ yeva Tathāgato dhammaṃ deseti no asakkaccam,
an5.99:2.5: upāsakānaṃ ce pi bhikkhave Tathāgato dhammaṃ deseti, sakkaccaṃ yeva Tathāgato dhammaṃ deseti no asakkaccaṃ,
an5.99:2.6: upāsikānaṃ ce pi bhikkhave Tathāgato dhammaṃ deseti, sakkaccaṃ yeva Tathāgato dhammaṃ deseti no asakkaccaṃ,
an5.99:2.7: puthujjanānaṃ ce pi bhikkhave Tathāgato dhammaṃ deseti antamaso annabhāranesādānaṃ pi, sakkaccaṃ yeva Tathāgato dhammaṃ deseti no asakkaccaṃ.
